# PWA Assets — Placeholder Status

This commit ships **brand-orange placeholder PNGs** for several PWA
assets so the install / standalone experience is functional today.
Real designer-made artwork should replace them in a follow-up
(Wave B asset polish).

## Generated by `scripts/generate-pwa-assets.mjs`

These are solid `#E8712A` PNGs. Run `node scripts/generate-pwa-assets.mjs`
from the repo root to regenerate them.

| Path                                       | Dimensions  | Used for                                       |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `splash/apple-splash-1284-2778.png`        | 1284 × 2778 | iPhone 14 Pro Max startup image                |
| `splash/apple-splash-1170-2532.png`        | 1170 × 2532 | iPhone 14 Pro / 13 Pro startup image           |
| `splash/apple-splash-1125-2436.png`        | 1125 × 2436 | iPhone X / 11 Pro startup image                |
| `splash/apple-splash-828-1792.png`         | 828 × 1792  | iPhone 11 / XR startup image                   |
| `splash/apple-splash-1640-2360.png`        | 1640 × 2360 | iPad Pro 11" portrait startup image            |
| `screenshots/dashboard-narrow.png`         | 1080 × 1920 | Manifest screenshot — narrow form factor       |
| `screenshots/roster-wide.png`              | 1920 × 1080 | Manifest screenshot — wide form factor         |

**Replacement plan**: art should include the BAK wordmark + a hint of
the dashboard background (cream / orange gradient) at the splash sizes,
and real annotated screenshots of the daily ops dashboard + roster
planner for the manifest screenshots.

## Generated via `sips` from existing icons

These are resized copies of `icons/icon-512x512.png`. iOS scales the
512 down acceptably, but a true designer-cut icon at each size would
look sharper. Re-generate with `sips -z <px> <px> source.png --out dest.png`.

| Path                                       | Dimensions | Used for                              |
| ------------------------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `icons/apple-touch-icon-180.png`           | 180 × 180  | iPhone home screen icon               |
| `icons/apple-touch-icon-167.png`           | 167 × 167  | iPad Pro home screen icon             |
| `icons/apple-touch-icon-152.png`           | 152 × 152  | iPad / iPad mini home screen icon     |
